name: Joincare Pharmaceutical Group Industry Co.,Ltd.
summary: Joincare Pharmaceutical Group Industry Co.,Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and sale of pharmaceuticals and health care products in China and internationally. The company offers chemical pharmaceuticals for respiratory, gastroenterology, assisted reproduction, psychiatry, and anti-infection; chemical APIs and intermediates for drugs for humans and veterinary drugs; and traditional Chinese medicine, including cold medicine anti-viral granules and anti-tumor medicine.
